expected_structural_delta: No new production modules, roots, state owners, protocols, or public operations. Extend one existing build path and one existing test file with mode-preservation proof.
minimum_design: Keep the existing disposable development renderer and preserve modes on every source copy. Prove the mode counterexample with a group-writable fixture under a restrictive umask.
outcome: When the development package renderer copies a checkout with mode bits that differ from its umask, the generated package preserves the source mode bits and keeps its content hash stable.

reuse_decisions.name: development package renderer
reuse_decisions.rationale: The existing disposable render copy owns development packaging. Preserving copy metadata at this boundary reaches the failure without a second renderer.

reuse_decisions.name: tests/dev-package.sh
reuse_decisions.rationale: The existing package determinism test already exercises --dev output and can add the mode-bit counterexample.
